title: A rename the agent passes with replaces under a different key name updates the stored staging cluster

turns.user: Our staging cluster is called heron-stg.

agent_captures.quote: Our staging cluster is called heron-stg

turns.agent_reply: Noted: staging runs on heron-stg. I'll use that context for staging commands.

turns.user: Give me the kubectl command to list the pods in staging.
turns.agent_reply: Run kubectl --context heron-stg get pods --all-namespaces. Drop --all-namespaces if you only need the default namespace.

turns.user: We renamed the staging cluster to osprey-stg last night.

agent_captures.quote: We renamed the staging cluster to osprey-stg

turns.agent_reply: Updated: the staging cluster is now osprey-stg. heron-stg no longer applies.

turns.user: Give me the command to follow the logs of the api deployment in staging.
turns.agent_reply: Run kubectl --context osprey-stg logs -f deployment/api. Add --since=10m if you only want recent lines.

turns.user: Point the smoke tests at staging. Which kube context goes in the config?
turns.agent_reply: osprey-stg. Set KUBE_CONTEXT=osprey-stg in tests/smoke/.env and the runner picks it up.
You're welcome. The smoke tests will run against osprey-stg from now on.
